entities.name: Query protein (522 aa)
observations: 522-aa sequence; estimated molecular mass 55.85 kDa and theoretical pI 6.03.
Best reviewed homolog is Synechocystis sp. Nnr (UniProt P74217), 49.5% identity over 94.6% query coverage (E=5.69e-159).
Moderate homology supports bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair activity: epimerization (EC 5.1.99.6) and ADP-dependent dehydration of the S-form (EC 4.2.1.136).
Homolog annotation reports one potassium ion per subunit; candidate reactions include repair of both NADHX and NADPHX forms.
Likely role in metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolism; exact localization, oligomeric state, and direct experimental validation for this sequence were not established.
